title: Tristana away from Kha'Zix
prompt: Stage 3-5. Next opponent has Kha'Zix in his back corner; he leaps to the farthest enemy in his range at the start of combat. Tristana with two items is on your bench. Rek'Sai and Kobuko on row 2 are your bodyguards. Place her.
explanation:
Kha'Zix leaps to the farthest enemy he can reach. From a back corner, the farthest hex is your opposite back corner; the closest thing to a safe hex is the middle of your back two rows. Put Tristana in the centre-back with Rek'Sai and Kobuko on either side one row ahead: Kha'Zix lands on a corner, finds a bruiser or nothing, and Tristana keeps attacking with infinite range while her charge is up.

A corner is the default that gets punished here. Row 2 centre is also fine: still behind the tanks and even farther from both corners.
principle: Divers land on the hex farthest from them. Scout where they start and keep the carry away from the corner they will pick.
commonMistake: Cornering the carry by habit because it is right against most boards, and the diver is the one board where it is wrong.
